components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action a section wants. Large on purpose: at poster scale a small CTA reads as an afterthought.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.7rem; font-family: var(--font-jetbrains-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.84rem; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #F7EFE6; background: #CC0000; border: 1px solid #CC0000; border-radius: 2px; padding: 1.25rem 2.8rem; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #FF1111; border-color: #FF1111; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(204,0,0,0.4), 0 0 34px rgba(204,0,0,0.18), 0 12px 30px rgba(204,0,0,0.28); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF1111; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The secondary action. Transparent with the control-edge boundary; hover brightens the edge and widens the gap.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; font-family: var(--font-jetbrains-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.84rem; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #F2EFE9; background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(240,237,230,0.4); border-radius: 2px; padding: 1.25rem 2rem; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, gap 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover, .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { border-color: #F2EFE9; gap: 0.85rem; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF1111; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Eyebrow
components.description: A plain mono section label. No decoration, no trailing hairline, uppercased by CSS.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { font-family: var(--font-jetbrains-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.78rem; letter-spacing: 0.28em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(240,237,230,0.55); margin: 0; }

components.name: Field Row (link)
components.description: The container language for every list: no rules, separation is air and type scale. A row that IS the control paints a full-bleed red reach field on hover and every ink goes full cream.

components.css: .ds-field { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: #050505; } .ds-field-row { position: relative; isolation: isolate; padding: 2rem 0; } .ds-row-link { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 0.6rem 2rem; align-items: end; color: #F2EFE9; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.28s ease; } .ds-row-link::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0 -2rem; background: #CC0000; opacity: 0; z-index: -1; transition: opacity 0.28s ease; } .ds-row-link:hover::before { opacity: 1; } .ds-row-link:hover, .ds-row-link:hover * { color: #F7EFE6; } .ds-row-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF1111; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-row-meta { grid-column: 1; font-family: var(--font-jetbrains-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.74rem; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(240,237,230,0.55); } .ds-row-title { grid-column: 1; font-family: var(--font-bebas-neue, 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif); font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 4vw, 3.4rem); line-height: 1.06; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-row-figure { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1 / span 2; font-family: var(--font-bebas-neue, 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif); font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 4.2vw, 4rem); line-height: 0.84; color: rgba(240,237,230,0.55); }

components.name: Lit Field
components.description: The text field: a dark plate with the control-edge boundary, warming to accent-hot on focus. Keyboard focus adds the ring tight against the edge.
components.html: <label class="ds-lit-label">Company name<input class="ds-lit-field" type="text" placeholder="Acme Example s.r.o."></label>
components.css: .ds-lit-label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: var(--font-jetbrains-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.78rem; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(240,237,230,0.62); } .ds-lit-field { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.85rem 0.95rem; background: #0E0C0B; border: 1px solid rgba(240,237,230,0.4); border-radius: 2px; color: #F2EFE9; font-family: var(--font-special-elite, 'Special Elite', cursive); font-size: 1.05rem; letter-spacing: 0.01em; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; } .ds-lit-field::placeholder { color: rgba(240,237,230,0.5); } .ds-lit-field:focus { outline: none; border-color: #FF1111; background: #161413; } .ds-lit-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF1111; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-band-accent { background: #CC0000; color: #F7EFE6; padding: 4rem 3rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1.5rem; } .ds-band-eyebrow { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-jetbrains-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.78rem; letter-spacing: 0.28em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-band-title { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-bebas-neue, 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif); font-size: clamp(2.9rem, 8vw, 7rem); line-height: 0.84; letter-spacing: 0.005em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 400; } .ds-band-note { margin: 0; max-width: 34ch; font-family: var(--font-special-elite, 'Special Elite', cursive); font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 1.6vw, 1.5rem); line-height: 1.6; } .ds-band-btn { align-self: flex-start; font-family: var(--font-jetbrains-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.84rem; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #1A0000; background: #F7EFE6; border: 1px solid #F7EFE6; border-radius: 2px; padding: 1.25rem 2.8rem; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-band-btn:hover { background: #FFFFFF; border-color: #FFFFFF; box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.28); } .ds-band-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F7EFE6; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: A film-noir darkroom with one light: a single dark ground, cream ink, and red spent as a field or a fill rather than as small text. Headlines are poster-scale condensed caps, body copy is a typewriter face used as texture, labels are tracked mono. Depth comes from tonal panels, hairlines and a raking wash, not from shadows; the only glow is the CTA's hover halation. Lists carry no rules; the reach state marks an entry.
keyCharacteristics: One theme, and it is dark
Red is a field, a fill or a rule, never small text
Three faces: Bebas Neue, Special Elite, JetBrains Mono
Lists without rules; the red reach field on hover
No icon library; glyphs are text

rules.name: The Red Is Never Small Text Rule
rules.body: #CC0000 on #050505 is ~3.3:1. It may be a fill, large display type or a rule, never body, label, meta or error text; the focus ring is #FF1111.

rules.name: The Size Not Dimming Rule
rules.body: On the red field, hierarchy comes from size. Ink is #F7EFE6 at full opacity; 85% cream is for control boundaries only.

rules.name: The One Display Rule
rules.body: One --fs-display element per page. Sections run at --fs-h2.

rules.name: The Recipe Rule
rules.body: Every font declaration goes through _type.scss (mono, display, row-title, prose, hairline-link); every font-size through the ramp.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. The only shadows are the CTA hover glow and the print mount; red text is flat.

dos: Do compose a surface on the pencil canvas from the Components frame before coding it.
Do use global primitives by class name (.band, .eyebrow, .display, .field-row, .btn-primary, .btn-ghost).
Do give every data-backed page a .fallback-note.
Do use --field-border (≥3:1) for any interactive control boundary.
Do add a prefers-reduced-motion opt-out to every animation.
donts: Don't add a fourth font, an icon package, Tailwind or CSS-in-JS.
Don't put #CC0000 on small text or use --color-error as an accent.
Don't add rules, boxes or opacity 'inactive' states to a list.
Don't paint the reach field on :focus; focus draws a ring.
Don't introduce a prefers-color-scheme block for a single component.
Don't use translateX on the red reach field; the pull belongs to the warm wash.
